cohort.title: Fortune 500 domain cohort
cohort.scope: 500 company domains from Installmap’s 2026 Fortune 500 cohort; a third-party company/domain mapping, not independent verification of current rank or corporate ownership. All source rows retained regardless of source website-crawl success. New baseline, not comparable to the old Inc. cohort.
cohort.attribution: Source: Installmap, September 2026. Data: CC BY 4.0. Adapted to retain company names and normalized domains only.

definitions.denominator: All distinct sourced input domains, including invalid inputs and limited/error responses; no silent removal.
definitions.anyVendorFinding: Recognized MX/email-security provider or any categorized profile finding; inferred graph candidates and generic DNS hosting excluded.
definitions.productConfiguration: At least one direct non-wildcard CNAME/delegated-NS platform configuration in a business-product category; general website hosting, email delivery and mail productivity excluded. TXT/SPF alone do not qualify.
definitions.categoryCoverage: At least one categorized finding, including domain relationships and sending authorization. Not precision, recall, active use, or licensed adoption.
